question: Who among the following completed her/his 31st climb of Mount Everest in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kami Rita**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kami Rita Sherpa**, a legendary Nepalese mountaineer, successfully completed his **31st climb** of **Mount Everest** in **May 2025**, further extending his own world record for the most ascents of the world's highest peak.
 
• He reached the **8,848.86-meter** summit via the traditional **Southeast Ridge** route, a feat he has repeated almost annually for decades.
 
• Born in **1970** in the village of **Thame** in the **Solukhumbu** district, he grew up in a family of climbers; his father was among the first professional Sherpa guides after the mountain opened to foreigners in **1950**.
 
• **Kami Rita** made his first successful ascent of Everest on **May 13, 1994**, and has since dedicated his life to mountain guiding, working as a senior guide for **Seven Summit Treks**.
